WHAT: When app cold-launched via whisnap-ios://relay, NotificationCenter notification fires before ContentView subscribes → relay sheet never shown
WHERE: Whisnap_IOSApp.swift + ContentView.swift
HOW:
```swift
// Whisnap_IOSApp.swift
enum DeepLinkIntent {
    static var pending: String = ""
}
// In handleIncomingURL:
DeepLinkIntent.pending = "relay"
NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .keyboardRequestedRelay, object: nil)

// ContentView.swift
.onAppear {
    if DeepLinkIntent.pending == "relay" {
        DeepLinkIntent.pending = ""
        showRelay = true
    }
}
```
WHY: @AppStorage persists across app restarts — if app crashes while pending=relay, every subsequent launch would open relay sheet. Static is session-scoped.
GOTCHA: Clear pending intent in onReceive handlers too so notifications + onAppear don't both trigger.
